name: ai-use-case-workshop
description: Guide groups through six conversations and produce their cumulative AI use-case portfolio.

interface.shortDescription: A group conversation with a cumulative workbook
interface.longDescription: Work through six short phases, compare grounded use cases and confirm a group portfolio. The companion local MCP server generates a PDF after every approved phase. Optional Prefab views support the shortlist exercise; the complete conversation also works in text.
defaultPrompt: Help our group identify useful AI use cases.
